data_objects.name: news_items
data_objects.meaning: News-item metadata and text accompanied by record-level sentiment scores.
data_objects.notes: Blank cells occur in optional attribution and image-link fields.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Serialized row index from an earlier table representation, not a content identifier.

variables.name: author
variables.meaning: Author or byline attribution for the news item.

variables.name: description
variables.meaning: Short description or summary of the news item.

variables.name: source
variables.meaning: Publisher or source identifier encoded as a text slug.

variables.name: title
variables.meaning: Headline or title of the news item.

variables.name: url
variables.meaning: Web locator for the news item.

variables.name: urlToImage
variables.meaning: Web locator for an associated image.

variables.name: text
variables.meaning: Article, transcript, or other main textual content associated with the item.

variables.name: neg
variables.meaning: Negative sentiment component score supplied for the record.

variables.name: neu
variables.meaning: Neutral sentiment component score supplied for the record.

variables.name: pos
variables.meaning: Positive sentiment component score supplied for the record.

variables.name: compound
variables.meaning: Aggregate sentiment score supplied for the record.

structure.description: Each row represents one news item and combines publisher, publication, link, text, and sentiment fields.
Unnamed: 0 is an integer-like row index; url is the item-level web locator, while source groups items by publisher.
Empty CSV fields encode unavailable optional metadata such as author or image URL.

uncertainties: The publication time zone is not included.
The sentiment method, score scales, and which text field was scored are not specified.
The relationship between a byline string and a canonical person identity is not defined.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv table was used as evidence.
